mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'FILE' task_type, CAST(f.id AS CHAR) task_id, f.file_name task_name, f.status, COALESCE(f.progress, 0) progress, COALESCE(f.error_message, f.process_stage) message, f.create_time, IF(f.status IN ('FAILED','UPLOADED'), TRUE, FALSE) retryable, IF(f.status IN ('UPLOADED','PROCESSING','FAILED'), TRUE, FALSE) cancellable FROM kb_file f INNER JOIN kb_knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = f.kb_id WHERE kb.create_user = #{userId} OR kb.visibility = 'PUBLIC' UNION ALL SELECT 'UPLOAD', upload_id, file_name, status, ROUND(uploaded_bytes * 100 / GREATEST(file_size, 1)), COALESCE(error_message, '分片上传'), create_time, IF(status = 'FAILED', TRUE, FALSE), IF(status IN ('UPLOADING','FAILED'), TRUE, FALSE) FROM kb_upload_session WHERE create_user = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT 'EXTRACT', CAST(id AS CHAR), CONCAT('文档抽取任务 #', id), task_status, COALESCE(progress, 0), COALESCE(error_message, task_message), create_time, IF(task_status = 'FAILED', TRUE, FALSE), IF(task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'), TRUE, FALSE) FROM extract_task WHERE created_by = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT 'IMAGE', CAST(id AS CHAR), prompt, task_status, COALESCE(progress, 0), COALESCE(error_message, task_message), create_time, IF(task_status = 'FAILED', TRUE, FALSE), IF(task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'), TRUE, FALSE) FROM ai_image_task WHERE created_by = #{userId} ) task_items WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR #{status} = '' OR status = #{status}) AND (#{taskType} IS NULL OR #{taskType} = '' OR task_type = #{taskType}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
